Keep boat itself exactly the same ivory/brown paint, same shape, interior, benches, scale, stern at bottom, bow at top and camera. Entire background right to all four canvas edges is one uniform pure vivid green. Do not move, resize or redraw the boat. No added objects or text.

Intended as a SMALL distant side-of-horizon scenery layer, not a destination. No vegetation, no green pigment on rocks. BACKGROUND perfectly uniform vivid RGB(0,255,0) #00FF00 technical matte. No sea, waterline foam, reflection, sky, cloud, boats, people, buildings, objects, text or cast shadow outside rocks. All background including gaps between rock shapes must be solid green. Reference is palette/style only, not a composite to copy.

No sky gradient, sea, rocks, land, sun, birds, text, extra objects or painted checkerboard. No green tint inside cloud, do not draw a green reflected rim. Reference is approved art style only.
